# `aitbc messaging dm inbox`

List this wallet's DM inbox — ciphertext metadata only, nothing decrypted.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc messaging dm inbox [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--wallet` | text | — | yes | Wallet whose address is the recipient |
| `--limit` | integer | `50` | no | Max rows (server caps at 100) |
| `--cursor` | text | — | no | Resume from a previous next_cursor |
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC URL |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc messaging dm inbox --wallet <wallet_name>
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc messaging dm inbox --wallet <wallet_name> --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
